about: Controls. Mod keys are read with Unity's legacy input (as other White Knuckle mods do) and are rebindable in BepInEx/config/melty.rocketknuckle.cfg; game actions are White Knuckle's own InputManager names.

columns.source: modkey (mod's own, rebindable) or gameaction (White Knuckle's InputManager action)
columns.defaultKey: Unity KeyCode name for modkey rows; action name for gameaction rows
columns.configSection: BepInEx config section (modkey rows) or none

rows.action: swap White Knuckle hands <-> TF2 launchers
fire (stickies: hold to charge, release to launch)

rows.when: TF2 mode, airborne after a blast

rows.action: crouched blasts push harder, as in TF2
